lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a grid-like configuration with the largest centroids appearing along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating distinct nodes of high luminance where the vertical and horizontal axes meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-dark gradient indicating raised structural features.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Three elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (consistent with remoras) are visible attached to or swimming immediately adjacent to the ventral flank and pectoral fin base.
